description: This file defines the LDAPUserLookupSetting class, which encapsulates configuration settings for LDAP user lookup operations, including search scope, attribute mappings, and filters within the LDAP integration of the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: LDAPUserLookupSetting
classes.description: A class representing LDAP user lookup configuration, including parameters such as base distinguished name (DN), search scope, attributes, and filters, with methods for manipulating and creating such settings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an LDAPUserLookupSetting with a specified base DN and default employee selector mapping.

methods.name: getBaseDN
methods.description: Returns the base distinguished name (DN) for LDAP searches.

methods.name: getSearchScope
methods.description: Returns the current search scope setting.

methods.name: setSearchScope
methods.description: Sets the LDAP search scope; accepts only predefined scope constants.

methods.name: getUserNameAttribute
methods.description: Returns the LDAP attribute used as the username.

methods.name: setUserNameAttribute
methods.description: Sets the LDAP attribute used as the username.

methods.name: getUserUniqueIdAttribute
methods.description: Returns the LDAP attribute used as the unique user ID.

methods.name: setUserUniqueIdAttribute
methods.description: Sets the LDAP attribute used as the unique user ID.

methods.name: getUserSearchFilter
methods.description: Returns the LDAP search filter used for user search.

methods.name: setUserSearchFilter
methods.description: Sets the LDAP search filter used for user search.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Exports the current LDAP user lookup settings as an associative array.

methods.name: createFromArray
methods.description: Factory method to create an LDAPUserLookupSetting instance from an array of setting values.
